children: OPay, a Nigeria-based digital payments company, has applied to list its American Depositary Shares on the NYSE under the ticker symbol 'OPAY'.
The ADSs represent the company's ordinary shares.
The IPO price range is yet to be determined.

backed company said Stanbic Africa has agreed to purchase ordinary shares. The aggregate subscription price will be either $200M, the U.S. dollar equivalent of 0.98% of Standard Bank's qualifying regulatory capital, or the product of 4.99% of the issued and outstanding shares and the price per share obtained by dividing the final IPO price per ADS by the number of ordinary shares represented by one ADS.
Additionally, the underwriters will be granted the right to purchase additional ADSs.
Net proceeds are intended to be used for general corporate purposes, including to fund growth initiatives and for potential acquisitions or strategic investments.
